units.name: Grunt
units.description: Brutish warrior that trades footwork for raw bulk.
units.lore: Axe, hide, teeth. A grunt needs nothing else and asks for nothing else, and the warchief never has to ask twice.

units.name: Peon
units.description: Labourer with a shovel, thrown at the wall before the warriors.
units.lore: Not a warrior, just a body with a shovel and nowhere else to be. The horde throws peons first and counts them last.

units.name: Wolf Rider
units.description: Swift mounted raider that punishes gaps in the line.
units.lore: The wolf chose the rider, not the other way around. Together they outrun the arrow and bite before the bow is drawn.

units.name: Troll
units.description: Lumbering berserker that soaks a whole volley.
units.lore: Trolls heal what they lose and forget what they healed. Hit it hard the first time, because it will not remember to fall.

units.name: Headhunter
units.description: Elite skirmisher hitting far harder than its bulk suggests.
units.lore: Every skull on his belt was a warning nobody listened to. The spear is for the ones who still will not.

units.name: Shaman
units.description: Storm-caller worth gold to whoever drops him first.
units.lore: He speaks to the storm and the storm answers. Lightning is cheap when the spirits still owe you.

units.name: Wind Rider
units.description: Wyvern and rider sweeping over the maze instead of through it.
units.lore: A wyvern broken with meat and scars. The rider screams louder than the beast, and both of them like it that way.

units.name: Tauren
units.description: Horned colossus that walks through what others walk around.
units.lore: The earth shakes when the tauren charges and keeps shaking after. A wall is a suggestion it chooses to ignore.
